Match the following library locations to extracted script locations. The user specifically selected these 1 library locations for visual consistency.

EXTRACTED LOCATIONS FROM SCRIPT (9 total):
- Location ID: loc_walkup_kitchen
  Name: INT. WALK-UP APARTMENT, KITCHEN COUNTER — LATE AFTERNOON
  Type: interior
  Time of Day: late afternoon
  Description: A cramped New York walk-up kitchen reduced, in frame, to a stretch of bone-white laminate counter. Hard afternoon window light rakes across the surface, throwing clean hard-edged shadows from a cracked flip phone, a folded napkin set list, two subway tokens, half a bagel and a squat coral lipstick tube. Beyond the counter, out of focus, sit an old enamel sink, a kettle and a chipped tile backsplash. Also seen as a hero-product frame lit by direct on-camera flash.
  Architectural Style: Pre-war New York tenement walk-up; utilitarian small-space kitchen with old fixtures and painted-over trim
  Key Features: Bone-white laminate counter, hard window light shadows, chipped subway-tile backsplash, cracked flip phone, napkin set list, subway tokens, half bagel
  Ambiance: Quiet, clean, pre-departure stillness with a graphic editorial precision

- Location ID: loc_hallway_door
  Name: INT. HALLWAY BY THE DOOR — CONTINUOUS
  Type: interior
  Time of Day: late afternoon
  Description: A narrow apartment entry hallway, barely shoulder-width, with scuffed eggshell walls, a coat hook loaded with bags, worn hardwood floor and a heavy painted apartment door with multiple deadbolts and a peephole. Notably, no mirror anywhere. Light spills from the kitchen behind and from the dim hallway landing beyond the opening door.
  Architectural Style: Pre-war tenement interior hallway; layered painted plaster and old millwork
  Key Features: Absence of a mirror, cluttered coat hooks, multi-lock painted door, narrow claustrophobic corridor
  Ambiance: Rushed, intimate, over-the-shoulder urgency

- Location ID: loc_stoop_sidewalk
  Name: EXT. STOOP AND SIDEWALK — LATE AFTERNOON
  Type: exterior
  Time of Day: late afternoon
  Description: A brownstone stoop with worn stone steps and a black iron handrail giving onto a busy residential sidewalk. Parked cars line the curb bumper to bumper; a dense wall of pedestrians moves past. Low warm sun rakes straight down the street, flaring off windshields and a traffic light.
  Architectural Style: 19th-century brownstone row houses with stoops, iron railings and garden-level windows
  Key Features: Stone stoop steps, iron handrail, tightly parked cars, pedestrian crowd, windshield lens flare, traffic light
  Ambiance: Kinetic, sun-blasted, city-in-motion energy

- Location ID: loc_dumpling_window
  Name: EXT. DUMPLING WINDOW, SIDE STREET — EVENING
  Type: exterior
  Time of Day: evening
  Description: A hole-in-the-wall dumpling shop's takeout window on a narrow side street: a stainless steel ledge counter, a plastic-sleeved handwritten menu, a red awning and a warm yellow fluorescent glow from inside. Steam curls off a paper tray of dumplings; a squeeze bottle of bright red chili oil and a stack of thin napkins sit at the edge. Dark side-street brick and fire escapes behind.
  Architectural Style: Utilitarian storefront takeout window in an old brick low-rise; laminated signage, roll-down security gate
  Key Features: Stainless steel window ledge, rising steam, red chili oil, paper tray, red awning, handwritten menu
  Ambiance: Steamy, appetizing, quick pit-stop intimacy

- Location ID: loc_subway_platform
  Name: INT. SUBWAY PLATFORM — EVENING
  Type: interior
  Time of Day: evening
  Description: A deep underground express platform: white subway tile columns with black route bands, steel I-beam columns painted institutional green, gum-stained concrete floor, yellow tactile edge strip and a dark tunnel mouth. An express train rips past, its stainless steel doors and windows strobing light and smearing reflections. Tunnel wind lifts hair and litter.
  Architectural Style: Early 20th-century mass-transit infrastructure; tiled columns, riveted steel beams, utilitarian signage
  Key Features: Blurring stainless express train, strobing reflections, tiled columns, yellow platform edge stripe, tunnel wind
  Ambiance: Loud, rushing, exhilarating underground chaos

- Location ID: loc_train_car
  Name: INT. TRAIN CAR — CONTINUOUS
  Type: interior
  Time of Day: evening
  Description: The interior of a moving subway car: molded plastic bench seating in orange and blue, stainless steel poles and overhead grab bars, scratched windows showing black tunnel rush, ad panels above the windows, and a lurching corrugated floor. Passengers pack the frame edges in shallow focus.
  Architectural Style: Modern rolling-stock transit interior; brushed stainless, molded plastic, riveted panels
  Key Features: Stainless grab poles, orange/blue bench seats, overhead ad panels, swaying handheld motion, tunnel-black windows
  Ambiance: Cramped, jostling, workaday commuter momentum

- Location ID: loc_crosstown_crosswalk
  Name: EXT. CROSSTOWN CROSSWALK — NIGHT
  Type: exterior
  Time of Day: night
  Description: A wide crosstown avenue crossing at night: yellow taxis stacked and idling nose-to-tail with headlights blooming, a striped crosswalk with a red countdown signal, steam from a manhole, and a wall of illuminated office tower glass glowing behind. Wet-slick asphalt catches reflected light.
  Architectural Style: Midtown commercial corridor — glass-and-steel office towers, standard traffic infrastructure
  Key Features: Idling yellow taxis, striped crosswalk, pedestrian countdown signal, glowing office glass, headlight flare
  Ambiance: Urgent, electric, race-against-the-clock nighttime city

- Location ID: loc_club_back_corridor
  Name: INT. CLUB BACK CORRIDOR — NIGHT
  Type: interior
  Time of Day: night
  Description: A tight backstage corridor of exposed painted brick plastered with old flyers and taped set lists, black-painted pipes overhead, a scuffed concrete floor and a heavy black stage curtain at the end. A red EXIT sign spills crimson light down the bricks.
  Architectural Style: Basement club back-of-house; industrial brick, exposed conduit, blacked-out surfaces
  Key Features: Exposed brick, layered flyers, red exit-light spill, heavy black curtain, low ceiling pipes
  Ambiance: Charged, sweaty, moments-before-the-set anticipation

- Location ID: loc_comedy_club_stage
  Name: INT. COMEDY CLUB STAGE — NIGHT
  Type: interior
  Time of Day: night
  Description: A small basement comedy club stage: exposed brick back wall, a wooden stool and a chrome mic stand centered, a black scuffed stage floor and a hard single spotlight carving the performer out of blackness. Beyond, silhouetted heads at tiny round tables with candle glasses; the back-of-room wide shot shows the whole raked room. Also seen as a tight push-in and, later, empty under a bare work light with the crumpled napkin set list and a sweating water bottle on the floor.
  Architectural Style: Intimate underground brick-walled club room; low ceiling, cabaret table seating
  Key Features: Brick back wall, chrome mic stand and microphone, hard spotlight cone, black stage floor, silhouetted audience, stool
  Ambiance: Hot, adrenal, laughter-filled — then hollow and quiet once emptied
